""" cleaned = tag.strip() if _TAG_SANITIZE_RE.match(cleaned): return html.escape(cleaned, quote=True) return None def compose_post_html( poster_name: str, headline: str, text: str, hashtags: list[str] ) -> str: """ Construct a safe HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- poster_name : str Name of the author. headline : str Post title. text : str Main body of the post. hashtags : list[str] Tags to associate with the post. Returns ------- str XSS‑protected HTML string formatted according to USER_POST_FORMAT. Raises ------ ValueError If any required argument is not a string or if the template is malformed. """ # Basic type checks to guard against unexpected input if not all(isinstance(arg, str) for arg in (poster_name, headline, text)): raise ValueError("poster_name, headline, and text must be strings") if not isinstance(hashtags, list): raise ValueError("hashtags must be a list of strings") # Escape user supplied content safe_poster = html.escape(poster_name, quote=True) safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_text = html.escape(text, quote=False) # Preserve line breaks if needed # Sanitize tags and build span elements tag_spans = [] for t in hashtags: if not isinstance(t, str): continue # skip non‑string tags sanitized = _sanitize_tag(t) if sanitized: tag_spans.append(f'{sanitized}') tags_html = ' '.join(tag_spans) # Format the final HTML try: post_html = USER_POST_FORMAT.format( poster_name=safe_poster, headline=safe_headline, text=safe_text, tags=tags_html ) except KeyError as exc: raise ValueError(f"Template missing placeholder: {exc}") from exc return post_html
